instruction: Configure Apache with DAVLockDB and DAV On
output:
<think>
1. Task Breakdown:
   1. Generate the configuration: echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav
   2. Apply the configuration and verify with `echo status`
   3. Enable persistence across reboots if applicable

2. Tool Selection & Logic:
   Primary tool: `echo` — echo command execution and management
   Use pipes to pass data between stages without intermediate files

3. Safety & Edge Cases:
   FILE: verify the output file path is correct; use `>>` to append instead of `>` where appropriate
</think>
echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav
<Directory /var/www/webdav>
    DAV On
    DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/DAVLock
    Options Indexes
    AuthType Digest
    AuthName "WebDAV"
    AuthUserFile /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd
    Require valid-user
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf

   2. Apply the configuration and verify with `echo status`

    webdav.opts = ( "require-user" => "alice" )
    webdav.log-xml = "enable"

}' | sudo tee /etc/lighttpd/conf-available/90-webdav.conf
